about:
I am a Senior Software Engineer with a Bachelor's degree in Information Technology from VIT Vellore. I specialize in building scalable backend systems and search infrastructure, with a strong focus on semantic retrieval, distributed services, and data-intensive platforms.

My core expertise lies in backend and platform engineering using technologies such as Java, Spring Boot, Python, Node.js, and distributed microservices. I have extensive experience designing and implementing search and data platforms using Elasticsearch, vector databases, and large-scale indexing pipelines. I also work across modern cloud-native environments leveraging Docker, Kubernetes / OpenShift, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud platforms.

Currently at Oracle, I'm working on FHIR APIs and healthcare interoperability — building FHIR REST APIs on Oracle Integration Cloud with SMART on FHIR authorization, supporting clinical data exchange standards.

Throughout my professional experience, I have built scalable APIs, search services, and data processing pipelines that support high-performance applications. I enjoy solving complex engineering problems related to information retrieval, system scalability, and distributed architectures. I focus on writing clean, maintainable code and designing systems that are reliable, observable, and easy to evolve as products grow.

work.title: Senior Member of Technical Staff
description: Develop FHIR search and query capabilities, including support for escaped search parameters and multi-value filters.
Build Java and Micronaut REST APIs for core FHIR resources, with consistent request validation and error handling.
Implement SMART‑on‑FHIR authentication flows, including PKCE, launch context handling and token validation across provider, patient and system access.

work.title: Senior Software Engineer
description: Built a semantic search solution using Milvus and FastAPI to retrieve information across 10M+ policy records.
Developed an agentic workflow for Technology and Cybersecurity compliance, integrating internal systems such as Splunk, Confluence, GitHub and JIRA to automate evidence collection and reporting.
Created LLM evaluation and search workflows to improve retrieval quality and reduce manual assessment effort.
Contributed to platform modernization, observability and deployment automation across enterprise applications.

work.title: Software Engineer
description: Developed Java and Spring Boot microservices for enterprise search, indexing and document management.
Improved search relevance by combining BM25, ELSER and dense‑vector retrieval with hybrid techniques.
Implemented learning‑to‑rank pipelines to boost result relevance using user interaction signals.
Enhanced query matching through synonyms, phonetic search and NLP‑based techniques.
Built Kibana dashboards and search analytics tools to monitor query behaviour and improve troubleshooting.

work.title: Program Associate
description: Built REST‑based integrations between enterprise applications and cloud object storage to support bulk document ingestion.
Developed Spring Boot command‑line utilities to monitor distributed applications and reduce repetitive operational checks.
Integrated BDD automation using Karate, Selenium and Cucumber into Jenkins CI/CD pipelines.
Collaborated with platform teams on application reliability, testing and deployment improvements.

work.title: Intern Analyst
description: Developed a Python‑based predictive analytics solution to process financial data and evaluate machine learning models.
Built a React, REST and PostgreSQL application to visualise model predictions.
Collaborated with the engineering team through development, testing and deployment of the prototype.

work.title: Freelance Web Developer
description: Developed a responsive website for the ASCE‑VIT student chapter using React and Bootstrap.
Built reusable UI components and implemented responsive layouts across devices.
Worked with stakeholders throughout the development process, from initial design to deployment.
